fewShots.question: Which service categories have the longest average wait time?
fewShots.query: EVALUATE TOPN(10, SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(CommunityHealthAccess[ServiceCategory], "Average Wait Days", [Average Wait Days]), [Average Wait Days], DESC)
